name: ASKUL Corporation
summary: ASKUL Corporation engages in e-commerce business in Japan. It operates through the E-Commerce Business and Logistics Business segments. The company operates ASKUL, an e-commerce website for businesses where customers can shop for various products, such as office supplies, office living supplies, office furniture, and specialized goods for the manufacturing and construction sectors; general medical products for the healthcare, nursing care, and drugstore industries; medicinal materials, including pharmaceuticals and medical equipment; and food products, alcoholic beverages, and cosmetics.
